description: This file defines the high-level API for rate control modules in the RTL8367/RTL8367C switch, including functions for setting and getting shared meter configurations, port ingress/egress bandwidth controls, and egress queue bandwidth controls, along with related constants and data types.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeter_set
methods.description: Sets the configuration of a shared meter including type, rate, and IFG inclusion.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeter_get
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a shared meter.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeterBucket_set
methods.description: Sets the bucket size for a shared meter.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeterBucket_get
methods.description: Gets the bucket size of a shared meter.

methods.name: rtk_rate_igrBandwidthCtrlRate_set
methods.description: Sets ingress bandwidth control parameters for a specific port.

methods.name: rtk_rate_igrBandwidthCtrlRate_get
methods.description: Retrieves ingress bandwidth control parameters for a specific port.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrBandwidthCtrlRate_set
methods.description: Sets egress bandwidth control parameters for a specific port.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrBandwidthCtrlRate_get
methods.description: Retrieves egress bandwidth control parameters for a specific port.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlEnable_set
methods.description: Enables or disables bandwidth control on a specific egress queue.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlEnable_get
methods.description: Retrieves bandwidth control enable status for a specific egress queue.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlRate_set
methods.description: Sets the egress bandwidth control rate for a specific queue.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlRate_get
methods.description: Retrieves the egress bandwidth control rate for a specific queue.
